reviewer.method: Read entire public publisher preview and all four figure captions; visually inspect all four original figures. Inspect all nine packet mappings, nine allele descriptors and76phenotype assertions against accessible material. Full main and clinical table unavailable, so all nine mappings remain pending. Read62 supplementary VCF header lines and a bounded locus lookup only; no full VCF reading credit.

identity.title: Identification of two novel pathogenic mutations in the SKOR2 gene linked to cerebellar hypoplasia and a broad spectrum of neurodevelopmental delay in two Iranian families.

evidence.locator: Exact title, seven authors, DOI10.1038/s10038-025-01399-x, Journal of Human Genetics70:635-643; published1September2025, December2025 issue.

identity.note: Published article identity verified, but preview access does not establish full-main reading.

evidence.locator: Figure1-4 listing and Data availability link to supplementary folder; explicit subscription preview notice.
Only one visible VCF file in public folder.

component_inventory.note: Four figures exposed in preview. Full main/clinical tables and complete supplementary inventory cannot be established. Article says raw calls for both variants, but the linked folder lists only one frameshift-named VCF; additional missing files are not invented or counted as read.

extent_evidence.locator: 336lines of available subscription-preview extract, not the complete main article.

coverage.locator: Entire accessible preview including abstract, figure titles, data availability, references, disclosures and article metadata.

components.note: Partial main only: full methods/results/discussion and clinical table are behind subscription access. All extracted preview lines read is not full-text completion.

extent_evidence.locator: One complete Figure1 with full caption.

components.note: All pedigrees and linked Sanger traces inspected. IV1/IV2/IV5/IV6/IV7/IV13/V1 shown homozygous; caption extends homozygosity to affected relatives. III1/III2 and IV3/IV4 carrier traces, IV8 normal. IV11 drawn affected without its own displayed trace. X-rays IV6/IV7 and three-plane MRI IV13 identified using full caption.

extent_evidence.locator: One complete Figure2 with full caption.

components.note: Entire Family2 pedigree and all three traces inspected: II1 affected female, homozygous; I1/I2 heterozygous; II2 triangle. Do not infer pregnancy outcome details without the full main.

extent_evidence.locator: One complete Figure3 with full caption.

components.note: All a-e panels read: 10-species Arg125/Lys424 alignments, ConSurf scores/accessibility and NetSurfP secondary-structure predictions, legends and conservation scale. Computational prediction is not functional measurement.

extent_evidence.locator: One complete Figure4 with full caption.

components.note: All a-e panels read: domain and SKI alignment, SWISS-MODEL normal/mutant Arg125 structure, AlphaFold pLDDT90.58 and AlphaMissense model, frameshift sequence and1015-versus495-aa models. Predictions do not establish measured protein length, rescue or function.

coverage.locator: Header lines1-62 read from exact gzip source and saved header extract; remaining variant records not fully read.

components.note: Public folder has one frameshift-named VCF. Header hg38, GATK4.6.1.0, sampleBY0523. Bounded lookup finds0records at both packet coordinates, with476chr18records as control; not proof of variant absence or a verified sample match. Data counts are not reading credit.

limitations: Pending mapping: full main unavailable. Every snapshot retained; accessible observations are provisional annotations, not complete packet adjudication.
